name: The Hi-Tech Gears Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1986, Hi-Tech Gears Ltd is an auto component manufacturer and a Tier 1 supplier[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
THGL is an auto component manufacturer which supplies engine and transmission components to various OEMs in India and abroad

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 37.0% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 17.3%
cons: Stock is trading at 2.57 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 5.12% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 9.17% over last 3 years.
